import numpy as np

def clip_contrastive_loss(image_embeds, text_embeds, temperature=0.07):
    sim = image_embeds @ text_embeds.T
    logits = sim / temperature
    n = len(image_embeds)
    labels = np.eye(n)
    # Image-to-text loss
    probs_i2t = np.exp(logits) / np.sum(np.exp(logits), axis=1, keepdims=True)
    loss_i2t = -np.mean(np.sum(labels * np.log(probs_i2t + 1e-10), axis=1))
    # Text-to-image loss
    probs_t2i = np.exp(logits.T) / np.sum(np.exp(logits.T), axis=1, keepdims=True)
    loss_t2i = -np.mean(np.sum(labels * np.log(probs_t2i + 1e-10), axis=1))
    return (loss_i2t + loss_t2i) / 2
